name: setup-project-skills
description: Installs skills from a user-curated manifest (~/.claude/skill-manifest.json) into the current project's .claude/skills/ directory. Symlinks local skills, runs `npx skills add` for third-party ones, and advises `/plugin install` for native Claude plugins. Optionally scans the project for trigger files (Dockerfile, wrangler.jsonc, *.tf, etc.) and pre-selects recommended matches. Ships a starter manifest at skill-manifest.example.json.
